facts: patch_namespaced_config_map accepts a body object and passes that same body into _patch_namespaced_config_map_serialize.
The serializer assigns body to _body_params and calls ApiClient.param_serialize with method PATCH and resource path /api/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/configmaps/{name}.
The serialized request body therefore carries body metadata, including a supplied metadata.resourceVersion, rather than synthesizing or discarding that coordinate in this operation path.
V1ObjectMeta exposes the resource_version field for Kubernetes object metadata.
The model maps that Python field to the Kubernetes wire name resourceVersion.
The pinned ApiClient serializes model-backed request bodies for transport.
This closes the pinned client-side path from V1ObjectMeta.resource_version to the request body consumed by patch_namespaced_config_map.
Kubernetes uses metadata.resourceVersion to detect lost updates.
When the resourceVersion supplied by a client is stale, the API server returns 409 Conflict.
Clients that need lost-update detection can make either PUT or PATCH conditional on the existing resourceVersion and handle conflicts.
